title: The letter to Washington
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · from 2017 the aggregator
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (The Pitch Meeting That Isn't · deepening)
logline: Friday. Wood writes to the Washington plates. One line, the display face, the gull. Gully reads it before it's sealed and says it's the meanest thing he's ever drawn. Wood says it's not a drawing. Gully says that's what he means.

panels.composition: Gully's. WOOD lettering a note at the counter. GULLY watching. BARNABY II.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a thin man lettering a short note at a bait-shop counter while a stocky man watches

panels.composition: The note: 'The dog is not for sale. Neither is the town. He says hello. —A. Finch' The gull.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, close-up of a short hand-lettered note on white paper with a tiny gull mark
image.notes: Letter after: 'The dog is not for sale. Neither is the town. He says hello. —A. Finch' (Rhymes with dw_2019-11-21.)

balloons.text: That's the meanest thing you've ever drawn.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a stocky man reading a note upside down across a counter and reacting

panels.composition: The note in an envelope. The card from the cooler, damp, in with it — returned. The pup's nose on the envelope. Sealed.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a thin man sealing an envelope containing a note and a damp business card while a small dog noses it, no words

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; the pup's weight learned; Sundays wet-on-wet
art.palette: dailies: ink and one tone. Sundays: gray-green, fog, rust, bruised dusk

notes: 'It's not a drawing.' 'That's what I mean.' The card returned.
